redfin.remarks: Welcome to this charming south-facing pool home situated on a desirable corner lot in Arcadia, offering the added benefit of Temple City schools. This inviting three-bedroom, two-full-bath residence blends comfortable living spaces with thoughtful updates and an appealing indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The welcoming living room features a classic wood-burning fireplace and beautiful engineered hardwood floors that continue throughout much of the home. Abundant windows bring in natural light, while recessed lighting adds a warm, modern touch. A distinctive circular dining area surrounded by windows creates a bright and inviting setting for everyday meals and entertaining. The spacious kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry and workspace and is appointed with stainless steel appliances , subway tile backsplash, recessed lighting, and a practical layout designed for everyday convenience. An indoor laundry area with washer and dryer adds to the home's functionality. Dual-pane windows and copper plumbing are additional features that enhance the home's comfort and appeal. The three-bedroom floor plan includes a comfortable primary bedroom along with two additional bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The finished attic space offers valuable bonus area that can be used for a home office, playroom, hobby space, or additional storage. Outside, enjoy the private backyard pool and patio area, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying Southern California's year-round outdoor lifestyle. The gated front yard provides privacy and curb appeal, while the two-car garage offers ample parking and storage. The corner-lot location provides an attractive presence and additional outdoor space. With its private pool, desirable corner lot, south-facing orientation, primary bedroom, indoor laundry, finished bonus attic space, two-car garage, updated features, and convenient access to schools and local amenities, this Arcadia home presents a wonderful opportunity to make it your own.
